scope: MD Duck 0.1.0-beta.5 macOS arm64 and Windows x64 production tree: direct native neural inference; newly source-built English engine; exact five voice styles. Final platform acceptance and corresponding-source publication remain separate release gates.

closedItems.summary: guid-typescript@1.0.9 declares ISC but its integrity-verified published archive contains no license/copyright text. The npm gitHead is not available in the current upstream repository.
resolution: Obtain a rights-holder-issued full license/copyright notice for version 1.0.9
Or update/replace the ONNX Web dependency path and verify the final package no longer contains this code
closureEvidence: Direct native ONNX inference replaces the unused Transformers/ONNX Web path; guid-typescript is absent from the production lock and final-package gate. No license grant for the removed version is inferred.

closedItems.summary: phonemizer@1.2.1 wrapper commit and precompiled worker/data are identified, but matching eSpeak NG source revision, generated-data inputs, Emscripten/runtime version and corresponding build instructions are not identified.
resolution: Obtain exact engine/runtime source and build records matching the published package
Or replace the embedded worker with a pinned reproducible build whose complete source and notices can be delivered
closureEvidence: The old precompiled phonemizer worker is no longer included. Newly built ephone engine uses exact full source commit 4f6d246c1d3acf67a4d814e20da02fa3967bc92d, complete language/Unicode inputs, fixed Emscripten source and compiler image, and tracked rebuild script.
Two isolated builds reproduced exact engine and English data SHA-256; five neural voices produced sample-for-sample equality with previous Kokoro output in real q8 inference.
Exact source archives are verified and selected for the corresponding-source bundle; public binaries must be served only beside that full bundle.

closedItems.summary: All 28 top-level native component versions have collected license texts and versioned source URLs; complete per-file/transitive notices, a matching source bundle and user replacement/rebuild instructions are not yet delivered. The publisher uses a mutable libultrahdr PR patch URL.
resolution: Vendor and hash exact source archives plus pinned patch bytes and build configuration
Audit librsvg Rust crates and other compiled transitive/per-file notices
Confirm actual libultrahdr patch revision and provide/reproduce the replaceable native library build
closureEvidence: Unused Transformers image processing and sharp/libvips are removed from the production lock and final-package gate. No DLL/dylib from this retired image path is included. Historical version/notices/source gaps are preserved below, not asserted resolved for those old binaries.

closedItems.summary: The integrity-verified sharp Windows x64 archive embeds libvips DLLs with 28 component versions matching the recorded upstream notices. The Windows build uses libvips/build-win64-mxe; exact MXE/transitive source and patch records plus library replacement/rebuild instructions are not yet delivered.
resolution: Record and deliver the matching Windows source/build configuration and all transitive notices
Verify that the delivered sources reproduce or can replace the bundled Windows DLLs
closureEvidence: Unused Transformers image processing and sharp/libvips are removed from the production lock and final-package gate. No DLL/dylib from this retired image path is included. Historical version/notices/source gaps are preserved below, not asserted resolved for those old binaries.

speechSource.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (engine); Unicode database terms; Emscripten MIT/NCSA, musl and LLVM component texts retained verbatim
buildChanges: Use container cc/c++ for native dictionary compiler instead of a missing clang command
Omit --export-es6 on the data packager: MD Duck consumes only its generated file table, not its export wrapper
Omit upstream README regeneration referring to absent readme-header.md; input/output README copies are unchanged

modelVoiceSource.name: Kokoro voice style data
modelVoiceSource.scope: The five unmodified voice style arrays exposed by MD Duck. No upstream phonemizer worker or Transformers implementation is included.

model.delivery: Fetched only for requested neural speech; external model download is pinned and integrity checked before activation

normalizationSource.adaptation: Source-pinned engine import replaces original phonemizer import; normalization logic retained

tokenizerSource.adaptation: Exact vocabulary and normalizer pattern in src/main/kokoro-runtime-tokenizer.ts

correspondingSource.assembly: node scripts/stage-neural-sources.mjs --archives <verified public-source directory> --output <source package root>; merge only these selected inputs with git archive of the final MD Duck revision
correspondingSource.publicationRule: Serve the complete matching source artifact at the same official download location as both public binaries. Locally staged inputs alone do not establish public delivery.
correspondingSource.replacement: Rebuild the engine with node scripts/build-phonemizer.mjs --archive third-party/source-archives/ephone-js-4f6d246.tar.gz --verify; omit --verify for verified regeneration, then npm ci and normal platform build/pack commands. Docker is a maintainer build tool, not an app user prerequisite.
